title: scene-00: cite OMI, OpenSim/Hypergrid, VRM, WebXR
description:
From Mark 2026-10-21 prior-art review of draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00. Already cited: glTF 2.0 (normative), Hubs, Second Life, A-Frame/Three.js, Gather, tabletop sims, Ingress/Pokemon Go, Unity/Unreal/Godot. Add:
1. OMI group glTF extensions (OMI_spawn_point, OMI_physics_body, OMI_physics_shape, OMI_seat, OMI_audio_emitter, OMI_link). Scene defines its own spawnPosition/spawnOrientation (~L348-351) and physicsMode; cite OMI as informative and check alignment: say assets MAY carry these extensions and how they relate to Scene's fields (which is authoritative when both are present); no MUSTs on renderers.
2. OpenSimulator and its Hypergrid: closest prior art for federated regions and cross-operator region crossing; add to Influences and compare against Scene's region handoff design (record any gaps as follow-up beads).
3. VRM (avatar model format), if/where SceneAvatar references an avatar model; informative.
4. WebXR as a client-side hint for the 'ar' / VR view modes; informative.
5. Metaverse Standards Forum: at most an informative mention (coordination body, not a spec).
Render-check with kramdown-rfc + xml2rfc before committing.
